narrative: On the bookwheel. Holinshed lies open where the cat has left a margin. The page is a king brought into a city behind another man, and dust thrown on his head. No pen is in the hand. Nothing is written in the margin.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the page, and wrote nothing.

entities.name: Holinshed
entities.context: Shown on book in A king behind another man
